question: Where do the formulas live: a separate public nickpending/homebrew-prismis tap repo (the standard one-line `brew install nickpending/prismis/prismis-tui`), or a Formula/ directory inside the prismis repo itself (no second repo, but users run `brew tap nickpending/prismis https://github.com/nickpending/prismis` once before installing)?
answer: A separate public nickpending/homebrew-prismis tap repo, Homebrew's standard layout: its tap resolution maps `brew install nickpending/prismis/<formula>` to github.com/nickpending/homebrew-prismis, which is the only layout that gives the one-line install; the operator asked for the standard way.
